remarks: Welcome to 4 Union Ave #10, a corner unit, 1st floor, ranch style, renovated 2 bedroom condo in the heart of Norwalk. This complex features a pristinely landscaped courtyard, a fenced in-ground pool, vast parking lot, and meticulously maintained exteriors. As you enter the unit, the bright and spacious living area flows seamlessly into a well-appointed kitchen, featuring modern appliances, ample counter space, and new white cabinetry. The open layout creates an ideal space for entertaining guests or enjoying family meals. Down the hall, you will find two generously sized bedrooms, each offering ample space for furniture and convenient views of the playground and pool. In-unit laundry makes inconvenient Laundromat visits a thing of the past. Meanwhile, the fully updated primary and half bath will make something as simple as taking a bath feel like a staycation. Additionally, Lifeproof vinyl floors with insulated underlayment have been installed throughout. This home is situated a close commute from East Norwalk, SONO, and Main Street - offering a perfect blend of tranquility and convenience. With close proximity to local parks, public golf courses, schools, and shopping, you'll have everything you need right at your fingertips. Don't miss the opportunity to make 4 Union Ave your new home. Schedule a viewing today and experience the perfect combination of style, comfort, and location.
